# Noorza

Noorza is a Pakistani women's fashion and essentials store offering bras, bra sets, lingerie, and nightwear.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/)
- [Shop All](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/collection)
- [Bra](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/collection?category=Bra)
- [Bra Sets](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/collection?category=Bra%20Sets)
- [Lingerie](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/collection?category=Lingerie)
- [Nightwear](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/collection?category=Nightwear)
- [About](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/about)
- [Contact](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/contact)
- [Delivery](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/delivery)
- [Privacy Policy](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/privacy-policy)
- [Refund Policy](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/refund-policy)
- [Payment Policy](https://noorza-ecommerce-frontend.vercel.app/payment-policy)
